notes.title: Patch Notes Fix 1.0.1
notes.content:
A new version of Sky Captain's Return is live!

The update includes but is not limited to:

[list]
[*] Reduce the Lightcanon effect for more screen visibility
[*] Reduce Hitmaker for more screen visibility
[*] Add timer to Mines, to reduce and nerf mines placed on the map
[*] Remove Turret Projectile HIts if target leaves area before shot got fired
[*] Multiple Bug Fixing & QoL Improvements
[/list]
